articles.title_en: Borda’s Rule and Arrow’s Independence Condition
articles.title_cn: 博尔达规则和阿罗独立条件
articles.abstract_en: We argue that Arrow’s independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA) condition is unjustifiably stringent because it rules out making a social welfare function sensitive to individuals’ preference intensities. Accordingly, we propose a modified version of IIA, MIIA, that is a necessary and sufficient relaxation of IIA for taking account of intensities. Rather than obtaining an impossibility result, we show that MIIA together with several other axioms (satisfied by virtually all voting rules and social welfare functions used in practice and studied in theory) uniquely characterizes the Borda count (sometimes called rank-order voting) as a social welfare function.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们认为，阿罗的不相关替代项独立性（IIA）条件过于严格，因为它排除了使社会福利函数对个人偏好强度敏感的可能性。因此，我们提出了IIA的修改版本，MIIA，这是考虑到强度而对IIA进行必要且充分的放宽。我们并没有获得不可能的结果，而是证明 MIIA 与其他几个公理（几乎满足实践中使用和理论研究的所有投票规则和社会福利函数）将博尔达计数（有时称为排序投票）独特地描述为社会福利函数。

articles.abstract_en: We fully solve a sorting problem with heterogeneous firms and multiple heterogeneous workers whose skills are imperfect substitutes. We show that optimal sorting, which we call mixed and countermonotonic, is comprised of two regions. In the first region, mediocre firms sort with mediocre workers and coworkers such that the output losses are equal across all these teams (mixing). In the second region, a high-skill worker sorts with low-skill coworkers and a high-productivity firm (countermonotonicity). We characterize the equilibrium wages and firm values. Quantitatively, our model can generate the dispersion of earnings within and across US firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们完全解决了异质公司和多个异质工人的排序问题，他们的技能是不完美的替代品。我们证明了最优排序（我们称之为混合排序和反单调排序）由 二 区域组成。在第一地区，平庸的公司与平庸的工人和同事进行排序，使得所有这些团队的产出损失相等（混合）。在第二区域，高技能工人与低技能同事和高生产率公司进行排序（反单调性）。我们描述均衡工资和公司价值的特征。从数量上讲，我们的模型可以产生美国公司内部和之间的收益离散度。

articles.title_en: Enhancing Human Capital in Children: A Case Study on Scaling
articles.title_cn: 增强儿童人力资本：规模化案例研究
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides novel insights into the science of scaling by examining an educational mentoring program in Mexico. The empirical analysis encompasses two independent field experiments and seizes a unique opportunity to learn from the government’s implementation of the same intervention. While the program originally implemented at scale demonstrates limited effectiveness, the introduction of a new modality with enhanced mentor training significantly improves children’s outcomes. Mentor-parent interactions are found to stimulate parental engagement at the community-school level. Our findings support the hypothesis that parents can play an important role in facilitating the scalability of educational programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过研究墨西哥的教育指导项目，提供了对扩展科学的新颖见解。实证分析包括二独立的现场实验，并抓住了一个独特的机会来学习政府实施相同干预措施的经验。虽然该计划最初大规模实施的效果有限，但引入加强导师培训的新模式显着改善了儿童的学习成果。研究发现，导师与家长的互动可以刺激家长在社区-学校层面的参与。我们的研究结果支持这样的假设：父母可以在促进教育计划的可扩展性方面发挥重要作用。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Working-Memory Training on Children’s Cognitive and Noncognitive Skills
articles.title_cn: 工作记忆训练对儿童认知和非认知技能的影响
articles.abstract_en: Working-memory (WM) capacity is a key component of a wide range of cognitive and noncognitive skills—such as fluid IQ, math, reading, and inhibitory control—but can WM training improve these skills? Here, we examine the causal impact of WM training embedded in regular school teaching, using a randomized educational intervention with 6–7-year-old children. We find substantial gains in WM capacity and document positive spillover effects on geometry, fluid IQ, and inhibitory control. Three years later, treated children are 16 percentage points more likely to enter an advanced secondary school track.
articles.abstract_cn: 工作记忆 (WM) 能力是一系列认知和非认知技能（例如流畅的智商、数学、阅读和抑制控制）的关键组成部分，但 WM 训练能否提高这些技能？在这里，我们通过对 6-7 岁儿童进行随机教育干预，研究了纳入常规学校教学的 WM 培训的因果影响。我们发现 WM 能力显着提高，并记录了对几何、流体智商和抑制控制的积极溢出效应。 三年后，接受治疗的儿童进入高级中学的可能性提高16个百分点。

articles.title_en: Contiguous Search: Exploration and Ambition on Uncharted Terrain
articles.title_cn: 连续搜索：未知领域的探索与野心
articles.abstract_en: We provide a framework for analyzing search across correlated samples. The agent—a mineral prospecting team, a drug company, a politician—tracks observations over a Brownian path. The agent chooses the search speed and retrospectively picks the best observation when deciding to complete the search. We show that the optimal search speed is U-shaped: it is highest when approaching a breakthrough or when nearing search termination. Unlike search across independent samples, search optimally stops when observations are sufficiently discouraging, following a drawdown stopping boundary. We also show the tractability and features of optimal search contracts in our setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个用于分析相关样本搜索的框架。代理人——一个矿产勘探队、一家制药公司、一名政治家——追踪布朗路径上的观察结果。代理选择搜索速度，并在决定完成搜索时回顾性地选择最佳观察结果。我们证明最佳搜索速度是 U 形的：当接近突破或接近搜索终止时速度最高。与跨独立样本的搜索不同，当观察结果足够令人沮丧时，搜索会在下降停止边界后停止。我们还展示了我们设置中最佳搜索合约的易处理性和特征。

articles.title_en: Are Tax Cuts Contractionary at the Zero Lower Bound? Evidence from a Century of Data
articles.title_cn: 减税是否处于零下限的紧缩性？一个世纪的数据证据
articles.abstract_en: Popular New Keynesian macroeconomic models predict that cuts in various types of distortionary taxes are contractionary when monetary policy is constrained at the zero lower bound (ZLB). We turn to a long span of history in the United Kingdom to test this hypothesis. Using a new long-run dataset of narrative-identified tax changes from 1918 to 2020, we show that tax cuts are expansionary in both low-interest-rate environments and more normal times. We do not find evidence of a deflationary spiral at the ZLB. Tax cuts may therefore still be a useful tool to stimulate economic activity when monetary policy is constrained.
articles.abstract_cn: 流行的新凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型预测，当货币政策被限制在零下限（ZLB）时，各种类型的扭曲性税收的削减都是紧缩性的。我们转向英国漫长的历史来检验这一假设。使用从1918到2020的叙述性税收变化的新长期数据集，我们表明减税在低利率环境和更正常的时期都是扩张性的。我们没有发现零利率下限出现螺旋式通货紧缩的证据。因此，当货币政策受到限制时，减税可能仍然是刺激经济活动的有用工具。

articles.title_en: Targeting Precision Medicine: Evidence from Prenatal Screening
articles.title_cn: 针对精准医学：产前筛查的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the introduction of a noninvasive prenatal screening—cell-free DNA (cfDNA) screening—which is used to target a more costly invasive test that elevates miscarriage risk. Using Swedish administrative data, we document that coverage of cfDNA substantially increases cfDNA screening and reduces invasive testing. We develop and estimate a stylized model of prenatal choices and find that narrow targeting of cfDNA coverage can improve outcomes and reduce costs, while broader coverage also improves outcomes but with increased costs. These findings point to the potential gains from well-designed targeting of screening but at the same time highlight the importance of the targeting design.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究引入无创产前筛查——无细胞 DNA (cfDNA) 筛查——用于针对成本更高、会增加流产风险的侵入性检测。使用瑞典的行政数据，我们记录了 cfDNA 的覆盖范围大大增加了 cfDNA 筛查并减少了侵入性检测。我们开发并评估了产前选择的程式化模型，发现 cfDNA 覆盖范围的狭窄目标可以改善结果并降低成本，而更广泛的覆盖范围也可以改善结果，但成本会增加。这些发现指出了精心设计的靶向筛选的潜在收益，但同时也强调了靶向设计的重要性。

articles.abstract_en: We study how regulating data usage impacts innovation in digital markets. Platforms commonly use proprietary data about third-party sellers to inform their own competing offerings, dampening incentives for innovation. We model this interaction and characterize how data usage restrictions reshape these incentives. An outright ban on data usage may boost or curtail innovation, depending on the thickness of the right tail of demand for new products. More flexible rules controlling when and what data are made available can always improve the effectiveness of regulation. Our results contribute to an ongoing policy discussion regarding competition in digital markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究监管数据使用如何影响数字市场的创新。平台通常使用有关第三方卖家的专有数据来告知自己的竞争产品，从而抑制创新的动力。我们对这种交互进行建模，并描述数据使用限制如何重塑这些激励措施。彻底禁止数据使用可能会促进或抑制创新，具体取决于新产品右尾需求的厚度。控制何时提供数据以及提供哪些数据的更灵活的规则始终可以提高监管的有效性。我们的结果有助于有关数字市场竞争的持续政策讨论。
